_comments: PEOPLE DATA LABS as an MJ: Integrations row, so a company can hold its own PDL key on an MJ: Company
Integrations row linked to an MJ: Credentials record of type API Key ({ "apiKey": "…" }).
@memberjunction/actions-peopledatalabs resolves the key by this Integration's Name; with no company
credential it falls back to the PDL_API_KEY environment variable. ClassName is null on purpose:
this is a vendor API, not a sync connector, so the Integration engine has nothing to run for it
(MJCompanyIntegrationEntityServer logs 'No connector registered' and skips its pipeline).
No sync block: the release push writes that back. primaryKey from uuidgen.

fields.Name: People Data Labs
fields.Description: People Data Labs (peopledatalabs.com): person enrichment with education and employment history, person search, and school lookup. Used by the person-enrichment engine in BizApps Common and by the People Data Labs - Enrich People action.
